assumptions: The tickers were chosen by hand for this run. Results describe only these names.

composite_score is the sum of the FOUR data-scorable pillars only (growth 15, valuation 15, financial strength 10, free cash flow 10 = 50 points max). It is NOT the CLAUDE.md 0-100 score: business quality, moat, catalysts, risk/reward and management (50 points) require analyst judgment and are not computed here.

A pillar is averaged over whichever components have data, so a company with thin coverage can score on very few inputs. Check composite_max_available and metrics_unavailable_count before trusting a rank.
Financial-sector companies are scored on thresholds calibrated for operating companies and will be mis-ranked on leverage and cash-flow measures.
Ranking is a starting point for research, not a recommendation. Phases 2-5 of CLAUDE.md must still be done by hand.
_meta.disclaimer: Research output, not financial advice. Figures marked basis=vendor_estimate or basis=projected are forecasts, not reported facts.
